rules.name: Active Agreement Requirement
rules.statement: Order Requests must not be allocated to a Store Partner unless the associated Store Partner Agreement is in an 'Active' state.
rules.condition: During order allocation to a specific store partner
exceptions: Emergency manual override with senior management approval (proposed)
rules.if_violated: The order allocation is rejected and the customer receives a notification of unavailability
rules.rationale: Prevents operational chaos and financial disputes by ensuring only valid commercial relationships are utilized

parameters.name: active_state_threshold
parameters.description: Defines the specific status value required for allocation eligibility

rules.name: Minimum Order Value Enforcement
rules.statement: Order Requests may only be submitted if the sum of item prices is greater than or equal to the minimum order value defined in the active Store Partner Agreement.
rules.condition: At the point of cart validation before order submission
rules.if_violated: The order submission is blocked and the user is prompted to add items to meet the threshold
rules.rationale: Ensures economic viability of small orders and covers fixed operational costs for the partner

parameters.name: minimum_order_value
parameters.description: The mandatory minimum cart total for a specific partner agreement

rules.name: Dynamic Commission Rate Application
rules.statement: Financial Transaction Records must calculate revenue shares using the commission rate from the most recently active Store Partner Agreement valid at the time of transaction finalization.
rules.condition: During financial settlement and revenue calculation
rules.if_violated: Settlement records are flagged for manual review and potential financial reclamation
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate revenue distribution based on the current contractual terms, preventing over or under-payment

parameters.name: commission_rate
parameters.description: The percentage or fixed fee defined in the active agreement

rules.name: Escalation Hierarchy Adherence
rules.statement: Dispute resolution regarding Store Partner Agreements must strictly follow the escalation path defined within the agreement document.
rules.condition: When a contractual dispute or exception occurs between platform and partner
rules.if_violated: The dispute ticket is escalated to senior management for policy review and potential contract amendment
rules.rationale: Maintains contractual integrity and ensures consistent handling of conflicts according to agreed terms

parameters.name: escalation_path
parameters.description: The defined sequence of roles or departments for dispute resolution
